comment: Peak RSS budgets (MiB) per heavy test process. Healthy peaks measured 2026-10-20; budget is about 1.25x peak, rounded up. A file over budget fails. TT-1 (2026-10-22): world-stream peaked at 1286 MiB with three heavy files running at once (1216 MiB alone at root), and caves-reef-isles-retreat at 1009 MiB alone at root (98% of 1024), so both were raised.
